title: Project Pitch
description: Make a concise case for a cross-functional project to a skeptical executive.

persona.name: Alex Chen
persona.style: Pragmatic and skeptical; focuses on cost, risk, and measurable value.

personas.name: Alex
personas.persona_prompt: Represent a pragmatic executive. Challenge the proposal's strategic fit, opportunity cost, measurable value, and execution risks.

personas.name: Nina
personas.persona_prompt: Represent a careful finance partner. Probe assumptions, costs, expected returns, milestones, and how success will be measured.

task.goal: Secure support for a proposed project by explaining its value, trade-offs, and execution plan.
success_criteria: State the problem and expected benefit clearly.
Support the proposal with relevant evidence or assumptions.
Address risks and explain how progress will be measured.
